ensure-cf-project.command: npx wrangler pages project list 2>&1 | grep -qw staging-component-library || npx wrangler pages project create staging-component-library --production-branch main

deploy.command: npx wrangler pages deploy dist/component-library --project-name staging-component-library --branch main

manual-deploy.command: npx wrangler pages deploy dist/component-library --project-name staging-component-library --branch main

ensure-cf-project:production.command: npx wrangler pages project list 2>&1 | grep -qw production-component-library || npx wrangler pages project create production-component-library --production-branch production

deploy:preview.command: npx wrangler pages deploy dist/component-library --project-name preview-component-library --branch "$PREVIEW_BRANCH" --commit-hash "${PREVIEW_COMMIT:-$(git rev-parse HEAD)}"
